chunks: Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام was asked about a man who has dirhams and wealth owed to him by another man, and he invites him to his food or gives him a gift.

key_terms.الْمَالُ: property or wealth owed to someone
key_terms.الْهَدِيَّةَ: a gift given to another person
key_terms.طَعَامِهِ: his food or meal offered in hospitality
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a debtor to invite his creditor to a meal or give him a gift?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a debtor and creditor relationship. It indicates that if a person who owes money invites the creditor to a meal or gives him a gift, this is not in itself problematic.
